headline: Anthropic launches Claude Duet agent app via waitlist
summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI agent positioned against Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots. Access currently runs through a waitlist, open to US subscribers on Anthropic's Pro and Max plans.
